issue: जय जय जाहरवीर हरे — the refrain imitates जय जगदीश हरे, where हरे is the vocative of हरि; हरे could also be read as the verb 'removes (sorrow)', which the second line then explains.
our reading: Victory to you, Jāharvīr, O Hari
alternatives: Victory to Jāharvīr, who takes away (sorrow)

issue: भवन पधारो अटल क्षत्र कह भक्तों की सेवा करे — loose syntax: क्षत्र read as छत्र (royal canopy, protector); भक्तों की सेवा read as the devotees' service (worship). It could also be Jāharvīr serving (caring for) his devotees, and क्षत्र could be क्षत्रिय.
our reading: Saying, Come into our house, O unshakeable canopy, the devotees serve
alternatives: Called 'unshakeable canopy', come to the house; you care for the devotees

issue: माड़ी — read as मढ़ी (an ascetic's hut, a small shrine; cf. Gogāmeṛī); Platts's माड़ी (rice-water; a palm) do not fit.
